subject: general
question: What does the phrase "**back to the drawing board**" mean?

options.text: To start over after a failure
To take a short break from work

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "To start over after a failure". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"back to the drawing board"** means to start over or return to the planning stage after a failure or an unsuccessful attempt. (शुरुआत से फिर से शुरुआत करना) • **Example:** After the prototype failed during testing, the engineers went back to the drawing board to redesign it. • It signifies a fresh approach or rethinking a plan to achieve success. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: To complete a task successfully** (एक कार्य को सफलतापूर्वक पूरा करना): This refers to finishing a task or project with positive results. • **Example:** She completed the assignment successfully and received praise from her teacher. • **Option 3: To take a short break from work** (काम से थोड़ी देर का ब्रेक लेना): This means pausing work momentarily to rest or refresh oneself. • **Example:** After hours of studying, he decided to take a short break to relax. • **Option 4: To finalize a project** (एक परियोजना को अंतिम रूप देना): This means completing the final steps of a project to make it ready. • **Example:** The team worked late into the night to finalize the project before the deadline. • **Option 5: (None provided)**: No explanation is available for this option. 39:T65d, The correct answer is **option 3.**
